headline: PROPF collapse and EVER's 14% gap-down despite a 16.67% intraday rebound dominate today's coverage, while TU-PF posts an extraordinary 64.6σ volume spike.
market_take: Coverage is mixed with elevated volatility concentrated in PROP names. PF led decliners at -20.00% while EVER (PROP) and TPOLY (CONS) opened sharply lower before staging double-digit rebounds, signalling heavy intraday reversals. Unusual-trading volume is the day's defining feature, led by TU-PF's 64.6σ surge and AKS's 12.5σ spike, both sitting alongside notable filings. Several 5-day movers (EMC +100.0%, EVER +40.0%, TTCL +33.3%) and sharp decliners (A -23.5%, GEL -20.0%) confirm that price discovery has been disorderly across coverage.

Both names in coverage declined, with TRUBB -5.17% and STA -3.45% on roughly normal volume, no alerts attached.
